title: Rectified Flow: A Marginal Preserving Approach to Optimal Transport
tldr_zh: 速度场限制为 ∇c*(∇f) 的 c-rectified flow，声称不动点即 c-最优耦合；纯理论无实验
tldr_en: c-rectified flow constrains velocity to gradient form; author claims fixed points are c-optimal couplings via HJ equation. Pure theory, later shown to need stronger assumptions.
key_numbers: Example 3.5: rotation coupling (X0, A X0) of N(0,I) is straight but not c-optimal
